diagnosis: Customer is requesting API token rotation for their ETL job. Unified Auth accounts use scoped keys, so they’ll need to generate a new key, update their ETL job, and revoke the old key. No billing or entitlement changes are involved.
reply: To reset your API token for the ETL job, follow these steps for scoped keys in Unified Auth (see [Scoped API keys: create, rotate, revoke](https://support.example.com/kb-0003)): generate a new key with the required scopes, update your ETL job to use the new key, then revoke the old key. Revocation is immediate, so ensure all traffic is migrated first.
